short T_Local_Nolore
float timer

; Sielle's script - this controls her movement (recalling to the basement for Q3 and Q4 and then back to her original spot at the end of the chain)
; Controls her animations for casting the experiments and recall
; Controls her collapsing during Q3
; Handling for Q3 so that the player can't activate her while she is collapsed
; Handling so the player can't activate her during any of her animations
if ( menumode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC3 == 10 ) 
	if ( state == 0 )
		cast dispel ""PC_m1_SielleEumand"" ; cast dispel for the animation - looks like a recall
		set state to 1
	endif
	if ( state == 1 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 2 )
			disable
			positioncell 3670 3690 3750 22000 ""brina cross, guild of mages"" ; move her to basement for Q3 and Q4
			enable
			aiwander 0 0 0 60 20 10 0 0 0 0 0
			face 3782 3661
			set timer to 0
			set state to 2
		endif
	endif
elseif ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC3 == 20 )
	if ( state == 2 )
		""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->SetHello 0 ; prevents oddity where javrun runs over and says an out of place hello line
		face 3782 3661 ; Note: this is manually necessary so she falls the same way in OpenMW a Vanilla - doesn't actually change her facing for the animation
		cast ""dispel"" ""PC_m1_SielleEumand"" ; cast for the animation
		set state to 3
	endif
	if ( state == 3 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 2 )
			setfatigue 0 ; she collapses
			setalarm 0
			journal PC_m1_MG_BC3 30
			set state to 4
			set timer to 0
			""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->Forcerun
			""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->aitravel 3861 3728 3745 ; force Jarvun to run over in concern
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( state == 4 )
	if ( controlQ == 0 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 2 )
			set controlQ to 1
			if ( player->getdistance ""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight"" <= 300 )
				if ( GetDeadCount ""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight"" == 0 )
					""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->Forcegreeting ; Forcegreet as long as pc hasn't fled
				endif
			endif
		endif
	else
		set timer to 0
	endif		
endif

if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC3 == 50 )
	set state to 5
	if ( PC_Control1 == 0 )
		setfatigue 261 ; wakes back up at appropriate quest stage
		setalarm 100
		positioncell 3664 3625 3750 22000 ""brina cross, guild of mages"" ; so if she falls differently in different engines (she does) she goes back to a spot that makes sene
		aiwander 0 0 0 60 20 10 0 0 0 0 0
		face 3782 3661
		set PC_Control1 to 1
	endif
elseif ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC3 == 100 )
	if ( PC_Control2 == 0 )
		""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->ClearForcerun
		""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->aitravel 4178 3792 3745 ; when done move him back
		""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->SetHello 30 ; puts his hello lines back to normal
		set PC_Control2 to 1
	endif
endif

if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC4 == 80 )
	if ( PC_ControlA == 0 )
		face 3782 3661 ; not sure this matters but trying to make sure she faces the ring
		cast ""dispel"" ""PC_m1_SielleEumand""  ; dispel animation for 2nd experiment
		set PC_ControlA to 1
	endif
	if ( PC_ControlA == 1 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 4 )
			if ( getdistance player <= 300 )
				forcegreeting
			endif
			set PC_ControlA to 2
			set timer to 0
		endif
	endif
elseif ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC4 == 100 )
	if ( PC_Control3 == 0 )
		cast dispel ""PC_m1_SielleEumand"" ; dispel for the animation
		set PC_Control3 to 1
	endif
	if ( PC_Control3 == 1 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 2 )
			disable
			positioncell 3949 3984 4787 0 ""brina cross, guild of mages"" ; end of quest move her back to top of MG
			enable
			aiwander 0 0 0 60 20 10 0 0 0 0 0
			set timer to 0
			set PC_Control3 to 2
			set state to 10
		endif
	endif
endif
			
if ( OnActivate ) ; This is to prevent activating Sielle during her animations OR when she is collapsed
	if ( PC_Control3 == 1 )
		return
	elseif ( PC_ControlA == 1 )
		return
	elseif ( state == 1 )
		return
	elseif ( state == 3 )
		return
	elseif ( state == 4 )
		Messagebox ""Sielle is breathing but unresponsive.""
	else
		Activate
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

End
$00"

 SCPT.SCTX "begin PC_m1_TorioTulanus_sc

; Script to set magic effect on Torio during the first Brina Cross Mages Guild
short PC_Map
short control
short controlQ
short state
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short nofight
short nothief

if ( state == 3 ) ; after cured short circuit script
	return
endif

If ( Cellchanged ) ; ONLY run the paralysis script on cellchange so it only runs once
	if ( state <= 1 ) ; Make sure state is 0 or 1, prevents odd edge case of player curing, leaving shop and then returning before moving the quest forward and Torio re-paralyzing
		if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC1 < 10 ) ; BEFORE the quest short circuit
			if ( nofight != 1 )
				set nofight to 1
				set nothief to 1
			endif
			return
		elseif ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC1 == 10 ) ; Paraylze Torio if player ON quest
			setparalysis 1
			sethello 0 ; don't want any greetings playing while paralyzed
			set state to 1
			set nofight to 0
			set nothief to 0
		else ; If player has seen torio on the quest, but couldn't cure him and still completed quest cure Torio on next cellchange
			setparalysis 0
			sethello 30 ; add back in greetings
			set state to 3
			set nofight to 1
			set nothief to 1
		endif
	endif
endif
		
If ( state == 1 ) ; Only check for dispel if paralysis script has run
	if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC1 == 10 ) ; Only check for dispel if on the correct quest stage, mostly redundant
		if ( GetEffect sEffectDispel == 1 ) ; If player dispells remove and set state to 2 for dialogue
			setparalysis 0
			sethello 30 ; add back in greetings
			set state to 2
			set nofight to 1
			set nothief to 1
		elseif ( Geteffect sEffectCureParalyzation == 1 ) ; also if player cast cure paralysis
			setparalysis 0
			sethello 30 ; add back in greetings
			set state to 2
			set nofight to 1
			set nothief to 1
		endif	
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

end
$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin PC_m1_Vilter_sc

;Local script on NPC PC_m1_Vilter
;for quest PC_1-5_TheHelvorLegacy

short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short PC_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NoLore

short doOnce

if ( MenuMode )
    Return
endif

if ( control == -1 )
	return
endif

if ( doOnce != 1 )
	if ( GetDisabled == 0 )
		if ( ""PC_m1_Vilter""->GetTarget player == 0 )
			if ( getDeadCount ""PC_m1_Vilter"" == 0 )
				if ( GetDistance Player < 300 )
					ForceGreeting
					set doOnce to 1
				endif
			endif
		endif
	endif

	if ( GetDisabled == 0 )
		disable
	endif
	return
elseif ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Cha_PelLeg >= 90 )
	if ( GetDisabled == 0 )
		if ( getDeadCount ""PC_m1_Vilter"" == 0 )
			disable
		endif
	endif
	return
elseif ( GetDisabled )
	enable
endif

; cast divine intervention and disable 2 seconds later
if ( teleport == 1 )
	if ( control == 0 )
		set control to 1
		set timer to 0
		cast ""divine intervention"" player
		return
	endif

	if ( MenuMode == 1 )
		return
	endif

	set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
	if ( timer >= 2 )
		disable
		set control to -1
		return
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

End$00"

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin PC_m1_Volanil_sc

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short control
short controlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem ""ingred_vampire_dust_01"" 1
		if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_Anv_Recluse >= 10 )
			set PC_m1_ImulavFulcius.control to 1
		if ( GetDeadCount ""PC_m1_ImulavFulcius"" == 0 )
				PC_m1_ImulavFulcius->forcegreeting
			endif
			if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_Anv_Recluse < 50 )
				journal PC_m1_Anv_Recluse 30 
			endif
	endif
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Quarra"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Aundae"" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell ""Vampire Blood Berne"" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
	if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_Anv_Recluse == 50 )
		disable
	endif
endif
	


if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects ""T_Vamp_Dis_Order"" )
		if ( ScriptRunning ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC"" != 1 )
			StartScript ""T_ScVamp_Order_PC""
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	elseif ( VampClan > 0 )
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

if ( GetFight >= 80 )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetWeaponDrawn )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpellReadied )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise == 0 )
	RemoveSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

if ( NoHello == 0 )
	if ( GetSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage"" == 0 )
		AddSpell ""Vampire Sun Damage""
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

AddSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Order
AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order
AddSpell ""Vampire Attributes""
AddSpell ""Vampire Skills""
AddSpell ""Vampire Immunities""
AddSpell ""Vampire Touch""
ModRestoration 75

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

End$00"

 BOOK.BKDT [CD CC 4C 3E 0A 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 FF FF FF FF 00 00 00 00]

 BOOK.TEXT "<DIV ALIGN=""LEFT""><FONT COLOR=""000000"" SIZE=""3"" FACE=""Magic Cards""><BR>
Dear Kha'Raji,<BR><BR>
I hope this missive finds you well. I provide rhetorical and oratorical instruction at the College of Firewatch in Morrowind. I read transcripts of your recent speeches in Cyrodiil regarding the virtues of abolitionism and the vices of slavery. I found both the content and style of your words to be passionate, inspiring, persuasive, and clear. I believe my students would greatly benefit from your experience as a prominent and outspoken orator.<BR><BR>
Ergo, I am writing to provide you with an offer of employment at our prestigious institution. You would be serving as an assistant professor of rhetoric and oratorical style under myself, with all rights and privileges afforded to our faculty. Of course, I understand you have a home and family in Anvil. As it is not my intention to uproot you from them, I have prepared a proposal to our College's headmaster on your behalf -- a new study abroad program in Cyrodiil for our students.<BR><BR>
My plan for our new study abroad program is as follows. Initially, you would teach classes in Firewatch with me for a time while we iron out the program's details. After you learn how our College operates, you would be free to return to Anvil. Periodically, we would transfer students to you from Morrowind to instruct in the art of oration. Graduates of your class would be free to stay in Cyrodiil to pursue other studies, if they so choose.<BR><BR>
Please let my courier know whether our offer of assistant professorship is acceptable to you. The College and I look forward to your answer, whatever it may be.<BR><BR>					
Sincerely,<BR>
Walks-Through-Shadow<BR>
Professor of Rhetoric and Oratorical Style<BR>
College of Firewatch, Firewatch, Telvannis District, Morrowind<BR>$00"

 BOOK.SCRI "PC_m1_GarAge_NotebookScholar_sc$00"
 BOOK.ITEX "tr\m\tr_book_open_ntbk02.dds$00"
 BOOK.TEXT "<DIV ALIGN=""Left""><FONT COLOR=""000000"" SIZE=""3"" FACE=""Magic Cards""><BR>
[This notebook has weeks worth of entries, surrounded by scrawls of Ayleidoon in the margin and various small notes that seem to be either terrible handwriting or a scholar's personal cipher.]<BR>
<BR>
...After days of searching through the chambers of this ancient castle, I was ecstatic to have discovered the grand library of Garlas Agea. And, oh, grand it is, indeed! I knew I was the first to lay eyes on these hallowed halls in millenia, perhaps the first unbound man in history. I began poring over scroll after stiff, crumbling scroll, and tracing etching after faded, corroded etching. It must have been weeks since last I've seen the sun, now. All I'm left with is this cold, manufactured starlight.<BR>
<BR>
Upon entering the library, I discovered a stone door that, unlike the many others in this ruin, didn't respond to any of the keystones I had collected, nor brute force. I assumed at first that I had simply not found the keystone and resolved to return later, to instead focus on collecting the lore this library had to offer. My discoveries in this library though, lead me to a fascinating conclusion: the door was to be opened by an incantation, but in weeks of research, I could not find it. When I realized that my rations had run out, I left, ecstatic about my findings, recorded here in this journal, but glum nonetheless that I had not discovered the secret to this door.<BR>
<BR>
I discovered then that by some arcane means, the door I had came through had been entirely sealed. It, much like the door on the story below, now no longer responded to my touch or to my keys. I suspect this to be the work of one of the many protective spirits that wanders this castle, simply going about its habits with no mind for the mortal it doesn't even know is within. Days on, I have resigned myself to my death.<BR>
<BR>
I refuse, however, to let my death be in vain. I dedicate this final entry to you, whoever discovers this notebook. My dying wish is for this to be published, for all my findings in this accursed library to be revealed to the world. I spent my last days starving, reading through more and more texts and recording them in this journal.<BR>
<BR>
Then, I had hope: I had found the incantation to open the door. I scrambled to the door, overjoyed, and opened my mouth to say aloud the incantation.<BR>
<BR>
Nought but dust came from my mouth. I was too weak to speak. Damn.<BR>
<BR>
I can only hope that you who discover this has the will to speak the incantation. I have recorded it as follows.<BR>
<DIV ALIGN=""CENTER""><BR><BR>
VA GARLAS AGEA GRAVIA YE GORIA LATTA MALLARI AV MALATU<BR>
<BR>
In the caverns of lore, ugly and obscure, shines the gold of truth.<BR>

Dear Cerdia,
<BR>
I truly hope this message finds you well.
<BR>
This is the sixth follow up letter I am attempting to send you, not including my two regularly scheduled messages that have received no response. I have moved past the idea that this is an unfortunate coincidence and know without a doubt that you are being somehow prevented from responding. I can only hope that my letters are still ending up in your hands.
<BR>
To tell the truth, I'm something of a wreck right now. I knew something was wrong as soon as my first letter went without response, but I only began to fear the worst as time passed and my follow up letters did as well. I must assume that you are suffering some sort of illness that makes it impossible to write back. I wish I was able to travel to Archad to be there for you, but that's sadly impossible right now. However, I have a plan to send you help.
<BR>
I've been actively attempting to recruit someone to assist you, but I'm sure you recall from my previous letters what I think of Goldstone's people. I doubt anyone in permanent residence here cares enough for anyone but themselves. Therefore, I must hope that a traveler from outside the castle is willing to make the trip. Depending on how long it takes to find this person, I may send the letter with them instead of through normal means.
<BR>
I hope it goes without saying that I am greatly looking forward to your recovery and response. I've felt the lack of your correspondence keenly, but that's only part of why it brings me so much joy to come to your aid. The other part is that I know you'd do the same for me.
<BR>
<BR>
Your friend,

 BOOK.TEXT "<DIV ALIGN=""LEFT""><FONT COLOR=""000000"" SIZE=""3"" FACE=""Magic Cards""><BR>
<BR>
Bluepox is a Pyandonean disease inflicted by a species of native wildlife. Members of this species secrete a toxic substance in their mouth which spreads the disease. The substance is sometimes harvested by local Maormer as an instrument of war, but it requires magical enhancement to keep its effectiveness on long journeys.
<BR>
Aside from the blue spots of pox which give the disease its name, almost all victims experience seizures. Severity increases gradually; in the worst cases, the victim can be completely incapacitated by full-body spasms. Finally, sufferers exhibit a heightened sensitivity to electric shocks.
<BR>
The disease can be cured through typical means, but if cures are unavailable I do know of a few ways to minimize the symptoms. The first priority should be to remove the victim from anything dangerous they could flail into. Bedrest should be encouraged if possible. Alternatively, a weak paralysis effect can be used to prevent the seizures. In extreme cases, physically binding the victim's limbs to their body and supporting their head with something soft will prevent the disease's worst effects.
